parsed.explanation: Worst exposure is a Tier-1 universal rule: the state bars gender-identity use of restrooms/changing rooms in government buildings including airports, schools, parks and jails, with criminal trespass after refusing to depart. One documented arrest (2025, up to 60 days, held in men's ward, case dismissed on standing, statute never substantively tested, no later arrest documented) shows the risk is real but not organised targeting or sweeps. Private businesses are outside the law, courts function and have enjoined some national measures, and about 55% of the population has local anti-discrimination protection, so remedy is partial not absent. National passport/entry discrepancy procedures add document friction, and state hate-crime/anti-discrimination law does not cover gender identity, subtracting further. No presentation offence, police campaign, or documented systematic violence offsets the facility/custody exposure — placing this at elevated, low-end risk rather than the unremedied 0.35 or reduced-risk tiers.
